text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while passing by the field——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Urara, the preparations for sowing the 
seeds are complete, desu! Let's do our 
best with passion!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, El-chan! I love pineapples too~!
choice_data_list: Are you doing farm work together?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! That's right! Farm work is heavy, so 
it makes for great training, desu!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh! Getting stronger while 
helping out the academy makes me super 
happy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Here we go then! Seed sowing! Strong! 
Dynamiiic!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, carrots of the future! Fly high into 
the ring known as the field! Desuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Scatter scatter scatter!!*)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho... heave-ho... Ehehe, grow up big 
and tasty~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their unique combination makes steady 
progress on the seed sowing. However, with 
just the two of them, it looks like it 
will take quite a while.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, a sudden entrant to the ring!? 
¡Bueno! You are most welcoooome!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Doing it with three people will be 
way more fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's have a race on the count of 
ready-go to see who can plant the most!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we completely immersed 
ourselves in farm work together for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Phew, and with that, finiiish! We are 
completely covered in mud from head to 
toe, desu.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But this is proof of our hard work! Good! 
Great! Nice fiiight!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It kinda feels like right after running on 
the dirt track! Ehehe, that was so much 
fun~♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. But the fun time isn't over just 
yet, Urara!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Since we've gotten all muddy anyway, let's 
play our hearts out even more!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Woohoo~♪ What should we play, 
El-chan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ahem! As for that——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I haven't thought of anything at 
aaaaall!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's it! Let's ask Trainer-san. What 
kind of game would be good, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, they asked for my advice. 
The activity that came to mind was——
choice_data_list:
Playing in the water instead of washing 
up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, water games! Nice idea! Then let us 
go to that place and splaaash, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the place we headed to together 
with the girls was...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: We're here, we're here~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Alrighty, first one in for water play~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's so cold! Feels so good! 
El-chan, hurry up and get in too~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, of course, desu! However—— Here 
comes a 'sudden entrant' luchador!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
——Now, 'Mambo'! From the sky into the 
water, diiiive!

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaargh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*SPLAAASH!!*)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Since we're playing outside, I thought I'd 
let Mambo spread its wings too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
——Whoa! The water went boom, that was 
amazing! El-chan, do it one more time~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! Next time, let us dive in 
dynamically together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though taken aback for a moment, I spent a 
fun time playing with the innocent girls.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wrestling! Sounds like fun~! El-chan, 
teach me some cool moves~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! Leave it to me, desu! Let us proceed 
to the special ring!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we headed to the park's sandbox.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
——Alright, here I go! Bursting out of the 
sand to deliver a sand preeeess!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*KABLAAM!!*)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Urara won't lose either~! Counterattacking 
with special mud balls--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Splat splat splat...!*)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! That was a masterpiece of a match 
with both of us at full power, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My heart was racing the whole time~! 
Let's do it again, El-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if entirely oblivious to fatigue, the 
girls played with unbounded energy.
